verdict.rationale: Typesense is open source (GPL-3.0) and can be self-hosted free on any server or local machine, via Docker, Kubernetes, packages, or a Terraform module. That gives users complete control over where their data physically resides. Typesense Cloud is offered as a dedicated-cluster alternative, but the evidence never shows whether it lets users pick a region. Missing for 10: documented region selection for Typesense Cloud clusters, explicit data-residency/compliance documentation, independent corroboration.
